cta.title: See Steps AI for education with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.

seo.title: AI chatbot for schools and coaching centres | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer course and admissions questions, capture enquiries and book counselling sessions on WhatsApp, Instagram and your website.

hero.title: Turn course enquiries into admissions.
hero.body: Share course information, capture enquiries and book counselling. Students and parents get answers at the time they are looking, often in the evening.
hero.reassurance: Course answers from your information. Enquiries saved to your CRM. Counselling booked in the chat.

questions.title: What students and parents ask.
questions.intro: The same questions arrive every admission season.

items.text: What are the fees for this course?
When does the next batch start?
Can I speak to a counsellor?

jobs.title: What your agent handles for your institute.
jobs.intro: From the first question to a booked counselling session.

items.title: Answer course questions
items.body: Fees, duration, eligibility and batch dates from your brochures and website.

items.title: Capture enquiries
items.body: Collect the student’s name, phone and course interest and save it to your CRM.

items.title: Book counselling
items.body: Offer times from your counsellors’ calendar.

items.title: Follow up
items.body: Send WhatsApp campaigns to enquiries when a new batch opens.

tools.title: Works with your tools.
tools.intro: Connect the calendars and documents you already use.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Keep fees and dates current in your documents, so the agent answers with the latest information.

items.q: Can it answer from our brochure?
items.a: Yes. Upload your brochure or connect your website and the agent answers from it.

items.q: Can we message enquiries when admissions open?
items.a: Yes. Send a WhatsApp campaign with an approved template to your saved enquiries.

problems.title: Where admissions get lost, and what your agent does about it.
problems.intro: Students and parents ask at night and on weekends. The first answer often decides where they enrol.

items.scene: A parent asks about fees at 10 PM. By morning they have called another institute.
items.fix: Your agent answers fees, dates and eligibility at any hour from your brochures.
items.ask: What are the fees for this course?
items.reply: The course fee is ₹48,000, payable in two parts.

items.scene: They ask one question and leave without a name or number.
items.fix: Your agent collects name, phone and course interest during the chat and saves it to your CRM.
items.ask: When does the next batch start?
items.reply: On 3 February. May I have your name and phone to send details?

items.pain: Counselling calls take days to set up.
items.scene: Back and forth on WhatsApp to find a time that works.
items.fix: Your agent books counselling straight into your counsellors’ calendar.
items.ask: Can I speak to a counsellor?
items.reply: Thursday at 5 PM is free. Shall I book it?

items.scene: Past enquiries never hear that admissions opened.
items.fix: Send a WhatsApp campaign to past enquiries, and your agent answers every reply.
items.reply: Yes, admissions for the March batch are open. Want the brochure?

agents.title: Four agents. One institute. Every enquiry followed up.
agents.intro: They share your brochures, counsellors’ calendars and student enquiries.

journey.title: One student, from first question to counselling call.
journey.intro: Here is what admissions look like with an agent answering at every step.

stages.title: Answer the course question
stages.body: Fees, duration and eligibility come from your brochures and website.
stages.agent: Yes, merit scholarships cover up to 25% of the fee.

stages.title: Capture the enquiry
stages.body: The agent asks only for the fields you switched on.
stages.agent: Thank you Kavya. I have saved your details.

stages.title: Book counselling
stages.body: Times come from your counsellors’ calendar.
stages.customer: Can I talk to a counsellor?
stages.agent: Thursday at 5 PM is booked for you.

stages.title: Follow up when a batch opens
stages.body: A WhatsApp campaign reaches past enquiries. Replies go to your agent.
stages.agent: The March batch starts on the 3rd. Want the fee details?
